WITH w AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id, p.category, o.status, o.fulfilment_type,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-11-30'
)
SELECT status, category='ZZ Test' AS is_test, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_line, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl,
       min(sale_date), max(sale_date), min(dispatch_date), max(dispatch_date), sum(gross_amount) AS gross,
       sum(CASE WHEN etl_loaded_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_etl, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS etl_vals,
       sum(CASE WHEN channel_code='WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wb
FROM w GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.gross_amount, f.net_amount, f.vat_rate, f.sales_line_id, p.category, p.vat_class,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date,
         f.sale_date, o.order_total_gross
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter, d.fiscal_period,
       count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_lines,
       sum(gross_amount) AS gross, sum(net_amount) AS net,
       sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - round(net_amount*(1+vat_rate),2))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gross_mismatch,
       sum(CASE WHEN gross_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_gross,
       min(dispatch_date), max(dispatch_date)
FROM l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.dispatch_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period IN (4,5,6)
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 3

WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.gross_amount, f.net_amount, f.vat_rate, p.vat_class, f.sale_date,
         o.dispatch_ts_utc, o.order_total_gross, o.line_count, o.status,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-20' AND DATE '2024-10-31'
)
SELECT 'vat' AS chk, CAST(date_trunc('month', sale_date) AS VARCHAR) AS k1, vat_class AS k2, CAST(vat_rate AS VARCHAR) AS k3, count(*) AS n, sum(gross_amount) AS v FROM l GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
UNION ALL
SELECT 'null_dispatch', status, NULL, NULL, count(*), 0 FROM l WHERE dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'order_vs_lines', NULL, NULL, NULL, count(*), sum(d) FROM (
  SELECT receipt_id, max(order_total_gross) - sum(gross_amount) AS d, max(line_count)-count(*) AS lc FROM l GROUP BY receipt_id HAVING abs(max(order_total_gross) - sum(gross_amount))>0.02 OR max(line_count)<>count(*)) x
ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS control_net_before_returns
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period IN (4,5,6)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_lines AS (
  SELECT f.gross_amount,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(w.gross_amount) AS web_sales_incl_vat
FROM web_lines w JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
